description:
In this vlog from February 2023, I went back to visit my home-country of Bangladesh and went to one of my favorite cities in the country, Sylhet. Situated in the east of the country, we explored the markets, the river, and the city's food, went off-roading into a nearby village to experience village life, and also went to check out the gorgeous Ratargul Swamp Forest. I lost a lot of the footage from the first day due to a mic malfunction so please excuse the missing footage from the first half of the day. That part will be uploaded with the audio issues to the Extras Channel

Check out my friend @LukeDamant's channel for more videos of us exploring Bangladesh.
